IRS990.MissionDesc: San Diego Theatres, Inc. (SDTI) is a not-for-profit public benefit corporation established to manage and operate publicly owned performing arts theatres. SDTI was established in 2003 by the San Diego Convention Center Corporation (SDCCC), as an operating unit of SDCCC. In 2012, SDTI became a free-standing, non-profit public benefit corporation under amended and restated Articles of Incorporation and Bylaws. SDTI markets, operates, and maintains the Civic Theatre and the Balboa Theatre.The Civic Theatre was constructed by the City of San Diego (City) on land owned by the City and includes a 2,967-seat performing arts theatre as well as a central HVAC plant (Central Power). The Civic Theatre is operated by SDTI under terms of a 50-year lease agreement with the City (Note 9).THE BALBOA THEATRE IS 1,339-SEAT PERFORMING ARTS THEATRE OWNED BY THE CITY OF SAN DIEGO, AND WAS RE-OPENED IN JANUARY 2008 FOLLOWING A $26.5 MILLION RESTORATION AND REHABILITATION. SDTI OPERATES THE BALBOA THEATRE UND
IRS990.Desc: THE CIVIC THEATRE IS SAN DIEGO'S HIGHEST ATTENDED PERFORMING ARTS VENUE IN SAN DIEGO. IT IS THE PERFORMING HOME TO BROADWAY SAN DIEGO, A NEDERLANDER PRESENTATION, AS WELL AS THE SAN DIEGO OPERA. BEYOND ITS OWN SERIES OF SELF-PRESENTED EVENTS, ITS VENUES ALSO SHOWCASE HIGHLY REGARDED MUSIC ARTISTS AND COMEDIANS THROUGH PARTNERSHIPS WITH OTHER PRESENTERS SUCH AS GOLDENVOICE, AEG, LIVE NATION, OUTBACK PRESENTS AND NEDERLANDER CONCERTS. THE THEATRE HOSTS A DIVERSE SCHEDULE OF CULTURAL, THEATRICAL AND MUSICAL PRODUCTIONS AS WELL AS FORMAL ASSEMBLIES, MEETINGS, AND COMMUNITY GATHERINGS. THE HISTORIC BALBOA THEATRE HOSTS DIVERSE PROGRAMMING THAT SERVES A WIDE RANGE OF COMMUNITY INTERESTS. IN ADDITION TO SUCH POPULAR CONTEMPORARY ENTERTAINMENT AS COMEDIANS AND CONCERTS, THE BALBOA THEATRE IS EXTENSIVELY USED BY SUCH LOCAL NON-PROFIT ORGANIZATIONS AS CLASSICS 4 KIDS, GOLDEN STATE BALLET, LA JOLLA MUSIC SOCIETY, SAN DIEGO BALLET, OUR LADY OF PEACE AND SAN DIEGO GAY MEN'S CHORUS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: SDTI is a public charity, and is exempt from income taxes under Section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code and Section 23701(d) of the California Revenue and Taxation Code. SDTI believes that it has appropriate support for any tax positions taken, and, as such, does not have any uncertain tax positions that are material to the financial statements. SDTI is not a private foundation.SDTIs Return of Organization Exempt from Income Tax for the years ended June 30, 2025, 2024, 2023, 2022 and 2021 are subject to examination by the Internal Revenue Service and State taxing authorities, generally three-to-four years after the returns were filed.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: SAN DIEGO THEATRES HAS ADOPTED A CONFLICT OF INTEREST CODE, AS MANDATED BY THE POLITICAL REFORM ACT OF 1974 OF THE FAIR POLITICAL PRACTICES COMMISSION ("FPPC"), WHICH COVERS SAN DIEGO THEATRES BOARD MEMBERS, AND DESIGNATED EMPLOYEES AND CONSULTANTS. SAN DIEGO THEATRES ADDTIONALLY ADOPTED A CORPORATE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY NO. 404, WHICH SUPPLEMENTS THE STANDARDS ESTABLISHED BY THE FPPC, WHICH ARE INCORPORATED IN THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST CODE.THE PURPOSE OF THIS POLICY IS TO PROHIBIT INDIVIDUALS FROM ENGAGING IN SITUATIONS WHICH CREATE AN APPARENT OR ACTUAL CONFLICT OF INTEREST TO THE BUSINESS INTERESTS OF THE SAN DIEGO THEATRES. WHEN ACTING FOR OR ON BEHALF OF SDT, COVERED PERSONS ARE REQUIRED TO ACT IN THE BEST INTEREST OF SDT.THERE ARE CERTAIN SITUATIONS THAT ARE PROHIBITED BY SDT AS CONFLICTS WITH SAN DIEGO THEATRES, INC. 14-1886373 ITS INTEREST. ABSENT FULL AND COMPLETE DISCLOSURE AND AUTHORIZATION BY THE PRESIDENT/CEO OR A MAJORITY OF DISINTERESTED DIRECTORS, NO COVERED PERSON MAY:(A)OBTAIN A CONTROLLING FINANCIAL OR OTHER BENEFICIAL INTEREST IN A VENDOR THAT SDT HAS A CURRENT BUSINESS RELATIONSHIP WITH;(B)ENGAGE IN A SIGNIFICANT, COMPENSATED, PERSONAL BUSINESS TRANSACTION WITH SDT;(C)ACCEPT MONEY, GIFTS (IN EXCESS OF THE LIMITS SET BY THE FPPC REGULATIONS), EXCESSIVE HOSPITALITY, LOANS OR OTHER SPECIAL TREATMENT FROM ANY SUPPLIER, VENDOR OR CUSTOMER IN WHICH SDT HAS EXISTING OR PROSPECTIVE BUSINESS RELATIONS;(D)SOLICIT SDT EMPLOYEES OR CUSTOMERS; OR(E)WORK ON OR FOR COMPETING BUSINESS WHILE BEING PAID BY SDT.
